audience.programmeDescription: Economics & Society at Leiden combines economic theory and empirical analysis with law, politics and institutions. Students examine welfare, inequality, climate change, migration and labour markets, and learn to assess economic policy and its social consequences. The programme is taught in The Hague in cooperation with Erasmus School of Economics. Tutoring supports academic and career development.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The university publishes a full programme outline, shown below. A complete UCR comparison still awaits confirmation of the detailed third-year and final-project requirements. This uncertainty does not establish that UCR offers no suitable study possibilities.

curriculum.limitation: The published outline totals 180 EC, including 30 EC of elective space and a 10-EC bachelor project. Detailed third-year, cohort and project requirements remain unconfirmed. This is an indicative programme outline, not a certified complete degree pathway.

componentNotes.y1-21151008y: Hands-on R programming, data preparation and visualisation support empirical economic analysis.
componentNotes.y1-21151026y: Introduces regression and the distinction between prediction, correlation and causation.
componentNotes.y2-22152006y: Examines climate damages, emissions, discounting and policy trade-offs, including work with an integrated assessment model.
componentNotes.y2-22152018y: Develops causal analysis through experimental and quasi-experimental methods, including instrumental variables, fixed effects and difference-in-differences.
componentNotes.y2-22152070y: European Law and Social Law form the selected 10-EC Package A. The alternative politics package is excluded; these are not universal requirements across both choices.
componentNotes.y3-open-electives: 30 EC in the first semester for a minor or other approved options, such as an internship or study abroad. No particular elective subjects are assumed.
componentNotes.y3-political-economy: The published final-year outline includes this 5-EC unit. Detailed module requirements still need confirmation.
componentNotes.y3-law-economics: The published final-year outline includes this 5-EC unit. Detailed module requirements still need confirmation.
componentNotes.y3-economic-history: The published final-year outline includes this 5-EC unit. Detailed module requirements still need confirmation.
componentNotes.y3-economics-society-2: The published final-year outline includes this 5-EC unit. Detailed module requirements still need confirmation.
componentNotes.y3-bachelor-project: A 10-EC individual research project combining economic, political and legal perspectives on a societal question. Programme-specific entry and assessment requirements remain to be confirmed.
